verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Codex runs tasks in isolated cloud environments and lets you delegate a longer task and return when it is ready. Tasks run in parallel without tying up the local machine, environments are configurable per repository, and results come back as a diff or pull request. The `codex cloud` CLI and Codex Web also let you submit and apply this work. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of cloud task execution, and documented details of the isolation boundaries (e.g., network or secret controls).

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment

citations.quote: Run tasks in isolated cloud environments, work in parallel
Delegate a longer task and return when it is ready.
